messages:
Maya Lin: Quick brief 72h sprint: need a one-pager + 1-slide benchmark for enterprise deploys (security + SLA + routing). Field-ready, scannable, CTA -> AE request form.
Owen Park: Keep it prescriptive: 3 quick decision bullets (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), 1 short SLA table, 2 benchmark callouts with % ranges, and inbound routing rules.
Rita Gomez: Design note: single 2-axis plot (latency vs cost) showing Hosted/Dedicated/Private markers + small caption. Two social cards: exec & technical.
Samir Banerjee: Eng: KV-cache reduces steady-state token cost ~2-4x on chat loads; Dedicated autoscale improves p95 by ~20-30% for bursty QPS. We'll provide ranges and caveats.
Maya Lin: Ops routing: Private/VPC/Compliance leads -> AE+SE queue. Hosted interest -> SDR nurture. OpsBot can you stub HubSpot form and set workflow tag?
OpsBot: Form stub created: https://app.hubspot.com/forms/secure-deploy-quick (draft). Fields: Company, Role, DeployInterest, Compliance, SLA_target, QPS_est, Region, Campaign. Workflow: tag AE_Private if DeployInterest=Private or Compliance matches HIPAA/FedRAMP.
Owen Park: Webinar idea: 30 min - 15 min benchmarks, 10 min migration demo, 5 min Q&A. Ask Eng-runtime + Field SE. Target 1 week post-publish.
Rita Gomez: I'll mock one-pager layout by EOD. Maya/Owen - add copy bullets in the doc: https://docs.google.com/d/secure-deploy-onepager-mock.
Maya Lin: Owners: Rita (design+export), Samir (benchmarks + eng signoff), Owen (webinar + routing copy). Publish target: 48h. Ping when draft live. :rocket:
